text: Speculation (Ūhā) is as follows: when one contemplates, "What is the truth here? What is the supreme? What is the ultimate spiritual benefit? How can one be fulfilled?", knowledge arises. [One realizes that] the Purusha is distinct from Pradhana, the intellect is distinct, the ego is distinct, and the subtle elements, the senses, and the five great elements are also distinct. In this way, the knowledge of the principles (tattva-jnana) arises, through which liberation is achieved. This is the first attainment known as speculation.
